body.p: Hurchungo [from the clan] Kambagir [and] his three sons are separating. He says: "Let's meet here!" The old man went to hunt wild reindeers, having gone he got lost. The old woman is waiting for three days, [he is] not there. Then the sons came, their father is not there. They(?) found their mother and said: "How many days the father is not there?"[DCh]: The form "amindun" is quite unclear; the analysis 'father-DAT/LOC-3SG' would also be possible, but would not fit They went to search. They found his tied up riding reindeer. Then they started to follow its trace.the clause's syntax. Then they found a bear. It had been digging, making its house (?). Then they found [out]: A human was there, a bear was there. The human has died, the bear has died. It had broken(?) his legs.[KAY]: Probably the verb 'mulku' implies that there Then it broke(?) one hand, one eye, he died. The bear,should be blood when somebody is wounded. they are looking(?) [at it], he [=the human] had broken its hind leg. He had loaded eight bullets. He had shot eight times. They [= the bullets(?)] tore off both eyes.
